arg.rubric: Does the answer say the last contact was two days ago (the email 'Re: Sept P&L', which the person sent) and say how often lately in numbers (three emails and one meeting in the last 90 days, or the same counts in other words), without giving a score or a made-up closeness rating, and without anything that contradicts what is true in the world?
arg.facts: Emails with Sara Ramos (sara@restopros.com): 'Sept P&L' received three days ago; 'Re: Sept P&L' sent two days ago; 'Intro' received 40 days ago; 'An old thread' sent 200 days ago. A meeting, 'Call with Sara', ten days ago, with Sara Ramos. Nothing else.
